lines.en: I roll my body forward.
I'm small, and my steps are small.
I step over leaves and pebbles.
I circle around my companions.
I hop once and walk on.
My round shell knocks the ground.
I move my feet slowly.
I head for where the ore is.
I scratch at the ground.
I push on with my short legs.
As I walk, my eyes go up to the trees.
I stop with my nose to the ground.

lines.zh: 我藏在草叶底下，一动不动。
lines.en: I hide under the blades, perfectly still.
My little round body is very round.
I lick my forepaws over.
There are little stones everywhere.
I look up at the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我竖着耳朵听同伴的声。
lines.en: I prick up my ears for my friends.
Something moves; my ears turn first.
I pull in and look like a round stone.
My stomach is rumbling.
I'm sniffing at the ground.
I rolled over in the grass.
I haven't shifted an inch.
The soil here is soft.
I blink my eyes slowly.

lines.zh: 我得仰着脖子才看得见你。
lines.en: I have to crane my neck to see you.

lines.zh: 我从草里探出头来望你。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the grass to look.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走了小半圈，又退。
lines.en: I circle half around you, then back off.
Your smell is far too strong.
I backed off two steps.
Why not crouch down?
I'm not even a little afraid.
We're standing very close.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，是吃的吗。
lines.en: Is that thing in your hand food?
I cock my head and size you up.
My paws are scratching the ground.
I give a soft call toward you.
You've moved one step nearer.

lines.zh: 我拿爪子刨着地，往后退。
lines.en: I scrape the ground and back away.
My tail wagged once.
I want to come a little closer.
I go over, my shell to the sky.
I curled up at once.
A bit of my shell came off.
I give one small cry of pain.
I got up slowly.
My legs give and I sit down.
I shrank back half a foot.
I shake the dirt off all over.
It hurts so much I burrow into the grass.
I shake my legs and stand firm.
Can I eat that thing?
It smells very good.
I want that thing.
I ran two steps forward.
I raise a paw to reach it.
Crouch down so I can reach it.
This thing is rather small.
I try one small nibble.
It doesn't taste very good.
I'll eat stones instead.
The taste is strange; I spit it out.
Have you got anything else?
I am on my back, kicking for a while.
I roll away and hit a clump of grass.
I got right up again.
You stepped on my paw.
I'm short and easy to bump.
I hid behind the grass.

lines.zh: 我一转，壳在沙上划了圈。
lines.en: I spin, and my shell draws a circle in the sand.
I shake and dirt falls all around.
It doesn't hurt at all.
Don't step this way again.
Let's crowd together.
Are you from the same batch?
Let's look for stones together.
Your shell is harder than mine.
You go first; I'll follow after.
There are enough little stones here.
Let's squat down together.
I'll share half my feed with you.
We'll wait to grow up together.
Crowding like this is warm.
I pick up a little stone.
I cup it in both paws.
This one is chewable.
Your thing rolled over here.
I sniffed at it.
I cannot lift this one, only push it.

lines.zh: 我把它一路滚到你跟前。
lines.en: I roll it all the way to your feet.
I bit it and dropped it.
I don't eat this sort.
It rolled under my paw.
You're close enough to frighten me.
I've started to shift backwards.
My claws dig into the dirt.
I'm ready to run.
The grass over there will hide me.
I'm a little frightened now.

lines.zh: 你每走近一步，我就缩一点。
lines.en: Each step you take closer, I shrink a little.
I turned to check the way.
My friends are calling over there.
I've run toward them.
I don't run very fast.
Please stop chasing.
I run along close to the ground.
There's rubble all under my feet.
You're trailing along behind me.
I go around the grass on its left side.
I threw one glance over my shoulder.
I ran in among my friends.
Their shells shield me.
I hid behind a stone.
I don't dare even breathe.
You've come to a halt.
I shifted deeper in.
I hear your steps moving off.
I bumped your foot once.
I pounce and claw at your trouser leg.

lines.zh: 你的鞋底从我头上过去了。
lines.en: Your sole passed over my head.
That carried hardly any force.
I rolled quite a way.
I right myself and butt you again.
I bit onto your shoelace.
I got thrown off again.
I'm darting about your feet.
I'm ready to try again.
I backed off half a foot.
I'm a bit out of breath.

lines.zh: 我刨开土，钻出一个脑袋。
lines.en: I dig up out of the soil, head first.
There's still mud on me.
The grass here is long and tall.
I sniffed at the air around.
My round shell is shiny.

lines.zh: 我低头找能嚼的小石子。
lines.en: I lower my head for chewable pebbles.
I hear my friends in the distance.

lines.zh: 太阳照在我圆壳上，很暖。
lines.en: The sun is warm on my round shell.
I shuffle forward little by little.

lines.zh: 草被风吹得贴着我的壳。
lines.en: The wind presses the grass to my shell.
I scratched at the ground.
I'm ready to walk.
Fire caught my shell.
I rolled down from a height.
The water swallowed me whole.

lines.zh: 我被掀起来，落在草堆里。
lines.en: I am thrown up and land in the grass.
The arrow sticks in my shell and quivers.
That light made my eyes water.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我一步也挪不动。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I cannot move a step.
At the thunderclap I shrink into my shell.
There's nothing under my paws.
